title: b11477: llama: share the nextn tensor flags between models (#30097)
summary: llama: share the nextn tensor flags between models Follow-up of the TODO in glm5-next: move the trunk-only and MTP-only detection that each model copied into a nextn_flags helper of llama_model_base. It probes the first trunk layer and the first NextN layer, and adds TENSOR_SKIP when MTP is not loaded. qwen4exp probes hc_attn_norm since it has no attn_norm. deepseek4, nemotron-h, qwen35, qwen35moe, qwen3next and qwen
body:
- llama: share the nextn tensor flags between models

Follow-up of the TODO in glm5-next: move the trunk-only and MTP-only

detection that each model copied into a nextn_flags helper of

llama_model_base. It probes the first trunk layer and the first NextN

layer, and adds TENSOR_SKIP when MTP is not loaded. qwen4exp probes

hc_attn_norm since it has no attn_norm.

deepseek4, nemotron-h, qwen35, qwen35moe, qwen3next and qwen4exp now

also accept a trunk-only file, like the other models.

- llama: avoid capturing structured bindings in the nextn flags

Lambdas that capture structured bindings need C++20, and GCC 15

rejects them under -Werror, so the models read the trunk and MTP

flags into plain variables.
summaryZh: llama.cpp发布版本更新，实现了多个大模型之间NextN张量标志的共享，将原本分散在各个模型中的主干层与MTP层检测逻辑抽象整合到基类中，并修复了GCC编译器在特定条件下的结构化绑定捕获错误。
